sections.title: Brave Frontier Heroes
sections.content: The eldest daughter of a family of heroes, and a heroine who fought against evil. Alongside her family, Rencia sought to stop the demon from regaining all its energy through its numerous evil deeds. During her battle against it, she combined everything she had learned from her parents and grandfather, and created her own style of fencing that could be dubbed the "Rencia Arts." However, this demon whose ambition was to conquer other worlds proved to be too much for the young heroine. Although her life and that of her family was spared thanks to one of her younger brother's teleportation spells, they all ended up scattered across the world, separated from each other.
